title: Uniaxial stretch of a neo-Hookean block to twice its length
source: Closed form of the compressible neo-Hookean model W = μ/2 (Ī₁ − 3) + κ/2 (J − 1)² in uniaxial stress (G. A. Holzapfel, Nonlinear Solid Mechanics, Wiley 2000, §6.5, eq. 6.148 with the volumetric term of §6.4): σ_yy = μ J^(−5/3)(l² − Ī/3) + κ(J − 1) = 0 fixes the lateral stretch l, then σ_xx = μ J^(−5/3)(λ² − l²)

quantities.quantity: axial Cauchy stress at the corner (1, 1, 1), stretch λ = 2
quantities.reason: a homogeneous deformation every element represents exactly: the tolerance only admits rounding and the Newton tolerance

quantities.quantity: lateral displacement u_y at the corner (1, 1, 1), l − 1
quantities.reason: a homogeneous deformation every element represents exactly: the tolerance only admits rounding and the Newton tolerance
